description.p: NiiX is a private messenger that runs entirely over Tor. It does not ask for a phone number, an email address, or an account of any kind, and there is no server that sees your contacts, your messages, or who you are talking to.
Your identity is a Tor onion address and a Signal protocol key pair, both made on your own computer. Use it on its own, or link it to the NiiX app on your phone so both share one account.

ul.li: Direct messages, groups, files and voice messages, end-to-end encrypted with the Signal protocol
Post-quantum session setup, so traffic recorded now can't be decrypted later
Messages go over Tor straight to the other person's onion address, with no server in between
Offline delivery through public Nostr relays, reached over Tor, as sealed envelopes they can't read
Disappearing messages, a duress passcode, and an optional wipe if NiiX goes unused
One account on up to five linked devices
Keys kept in your desktop keyring, the database encrypted with SQLCipher

description.p: Voice calls, between two people who have both allowed them, work as on the phone app.
First Linux release: messaging, groups, files and voice messages, as a linked device or on its own.
